_readme: Up to 4 reels, newest first. 'image' is a cover still saved in src/assets/reels/ (portrait works best). 'title' is optional: without it the tile shows the date. 'position' (optional) moves the crop, e.g. '50% 75%' to show more of the bottom. While this list is empty, the Reels section shows only the Instagram link.
